optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Quality Analytics Specialist, Automotive Parts Plant
professionalSummary: Quality analytics specialist with four years of experience at a body components plant, analysing inspection and scrap data and running statistical process control charts for twenty‑two critical characteristics on two stamping lines.
experienceHighlights: Analysed plant inspection and scrap data and ran statistical process control charts for twenty‑two critical characteristics on two stamping lines.
Prepared monthly supplier quality reports for two customers under supplier quality agreements, with reports accepted by customers’ supplier quality engineers each month.

Investigated capability drops with line supervisors under the plant’s investigation procedure, running measurement studies with the metrology lab; corrective actions approved by the plant quality manager.
Provided corrective action data to the plant quality manager for each investigation, recording ownership of analyses in the investigation file.
Wrote limitation sections and hand‑over conditions for each investigation file, filed with the plant quality manager’s approval record.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: one month’s control charts for one stamping line, one monthly supplier quality report and one investigation file with its approval record, including quality system references as a verification trail.

evidence.text: Quality analytics specialist at a body components plant for four years, analysing the plant's inspection and scrap data and running the statistical process control charts for the twenty-two critical characteristics on the two stamping lines.

evidence.text: Prepared the monthly supplier quality report for the plant's two customers under their supplier quality agreements, with the reports accepted by both customers' supplier quality engineers each month.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of report preparation and acceptance.

evidence.text: Investigated capability drops with the line supervisors under the plant's investigation procedure, running the measurement studies with the metrology lab; the corrective actions were approved by the plant quality manager.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of investigation and corrective action approval.

evidence.text: Provided the corrective action data to the plant quality manager for each investigation, recording in the investigation file which analyses were mine and which belonged to the supervisors.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of coordination and ownership recording.

evidence.text: Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each investigation file, filed with the plant quality manager's approval record.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of documentation of limitations and hand‑over.
